_readme: SPIM 4D pipeline config. Most users only need to edit input.directory, output.directory, and toggle the *_enabled flags. Paths can be absolute or relative to the repo dir. Input accepts a folder of per-timepoint TIFFs (t0001_*.tif, t0002_*.tif, ...) or a single hyperstack file (.czi, .tif, .tiff).

input._comment_directory: Folder = per-timepoint TIFFs named t0001_*.tif, ... File = single hyperstack (.czi, .tif, .tiff).
input._comment_channel: 1-based channel index. Ignored for folder inputs (channel is in the filename).
input._comment_max_timepoints: Optional. Only process the first N timepoints. null = use all.

output._comment_directory: Where to write results. Will be created if it does not exist.
output._comment_correct_y: Flip Y axis to fix microscope orientation.
output._comment_skip_merge: Skip the final 4D merge. Recommended for large data; you only need per-timepoint TIFFs for the viewer.

seqera_tower._comment: Paste your Seqera Platform access token to monitor runs in the browser (https://tower.nf -> Runs). Get one from tower.nf -> Settings -> Your tokens.

roi_cropping._comment: Crop every timepoint to a region drawn in Fiji (Edit > Selection > Add to Manager > save as .roi). Leave enabled=false to skip.

voxel_size._comment: Physical voxel size in micrometres. Required for tracking. auto_detect=true tries to read it from file metadata (CZI / OME-TIFF).

downscaling._comment: Optional pre-pipeline XY downscaling. Applied BEFORE segmentation regardless of whether preprocessing runs. 1.0 = no downscale. <1.0 trades resolution for speed/RAM.

raw_export._comment: Optional export of the RAW (unprocessed) input, sliced to be isotropic and downscaled so it can be overlaid on the tracks in ultrack_viewer.py. Runs INDEPENDENTLY of preprocessing/segmentation/tracking — the preprocessed chain still operates on the original-resolution raw input and produces its own volume. The exported raw volume is meant for visualization only (overlay with --processed in the viewer).
raw_export._comment_factor: XY scale factor (<1.0 = downscale). Independent of downscaling.factor — pick a value appropriate for napari display (typically 0.25–0.5 for a multi-GB acquisition). 1.0 = no downscale.
raw_export._comment_isotropic: Resample Z so voxels match the downscaled XY pixel size. Required for correct registration with the tracks in the viewer (tracks are emitted in isotropic coordinates).

preprocessing._comment: Modular preprocessing — three independent NumPy/SciPy steps (CPU only), ported from AIAF-32. Produces an isotropic, shading-corrected, depth-flattened stack ready for segmentation. Each step has sane defaults; override here only when you know why.
preprocessing._comment_planar: XY shading correction. Estimates a smooth flat-field from the mean-Z projection and divides every slice by it. Larger sigma_xy = smoother field.
preprocessing._comment_depth: Z intensity correction. Rescales each Z slice so a robust per-slice statistic (default p99) is constant along Z, with a moving-average smoothing window to avoid noisy single-slice spikes.

depth._comment_smooth_window: Moving-average window along Z (odd integer). <=1 disables smoothing.
depth._comment_gain_clip: Clamp the multiplicative gain per slice so dark Z slices do not get amplified to noise.

preprocessing._comment_isotropic: Resample Z so the voxel size matches the (smaller) XY pixel size. Cubic spline by default; linear is faster but blockier.

isotropic._comment_target_um: Target isotropic voxel size in micrometres. Set to the smaller of your raw X and Y pixel size.

segmentation._comment: 3D Cellpose segmentation. Runs on a GPU node. Set enabled=false to skip.
segmentation._comment_model: Path to a Cellpose model folder or a built-in name ('cyto3', 'nuclei', ...).
segmentation._comment_diameter: Single source of truth for the expected nucleus diameter (px). BOTH the main segmentation and the per-stage simulation read this value (spim_pipeline.nf line ~257 falls back to it).
segmentation._comment_anisotropy: Z/Y voxel ratio. null = auto-derived from voxel_size.
segmentation._comment_stitch_threshold: Stitching threshold for multi-FOV tiles. null = no stitching.
segmentation._comment_downscale_labels: Downscale the saved label volume by this factor. 1.0 = full res. Useful when the label volume is too big for the viewer.

benchmark._comment: Writes a small CSV/JSON with per-timepoint timing and memory stats.

tracking._comment: Cell tracking with ultrack. Set enabled=true to run the full chain (prep -> segment -> link -> solve -> export). Needs segmentation enabled too.

prep._comment: Foreground / contour extraction parameters used before linking.

system._comment: Container images and resume behaviour. Most users never need to touch this.
system._comment_resume: true = reuse finished tasks on re-submission. false = force a clean re-run.
